_comment: Counter-Strike 1.6 HLDS egg based on the current Pelican HLDS layout.
name: Counter-Strike 1.6
author: maximilian.rade@gmail.com

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# app 90 aborts halfway more often than not, so run it until the files are actually there
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_set_config 90 mod cstrike +app_update 90 validate +quit
    [[ -f /mnt/server/hlds_run && -f /mnt/server/cstrike/liblist.gam ]] && break
    echo "> Install incomplete, attempt ${try} of 5 ..."
done

if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/hlds_run || ! -f /mnt/server/cstrike/liblist.gam ]]; then
    echo "> steamcmd did not get app 90 down in 5 attempts, aborting."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: The server name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots. HLDS tops out at 32.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Empty means open.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console. Empty means RCON off.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: GSLT from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers, app id 90. Without one the server stays off the public list.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Appended to the start command, for example +sv_lan 1 -pingboost 3.
